newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline prompt demand pushes up values by $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline prompt demand pushes up values by $2.

text.p: Strong prompt requirements for gasoline continued to push up Eurograde barge values for balance-of-July Wednesday as first half August continued to lag well behind July.

The purchase of two fresh July Eurograde barges at $196 and $196.50 by a Benelux refiner, believed by dealers to be related not to refinery problems but to recent shipping delays, indicated a $2 rise on the day as it was quickly followe bidding at $196.50 and offers as high as $198.50, according to one broker.
A morning August trade was, by contrast, done at $182, according to dealers, who during the afternoon saw bid-offer deadlock in the $193-$194 range.

A September swap trade at $187 was the only widely identified swap deal of the day, which saw August values rise on prompt strength and higher values on the IPE and Nymex screens by $4-$5 to around $194, while September was $3-$3.50 up at $188-$189 by late afternoon.
Cargo bidding was meanwhile heard at $204 CIF NWE for 98 unleaded, with offers heard at $200 FOB Germany or $210 CIF.
